html:
Diagram atlas

52 diagrams, 14 animated flows

The room drawings are the 38 files from the study folder. The animated flows are ladders, routing, architecture, deployment, cutover, and a troubleshooting tree drawn for this course.

Completion ladder

One HTTPS call. The model returns scores over the next token.

Retrieval data flow

Find a span, cite the id, or refuse. The model does not mint the source.

Tool-call ladder

The host runs the tool. A schema match is not permission.

Voice ladder

The voice platform owns signaling and media. Emergency never enters this ladder.

Routing flow

Answer, refuse, or hand to a person. The router does not get the side-effect tool.

Architecture

Policy, retrieval, model, tools, trace, and a gate. A person sits on side effects.

Deployment

Pin the ids, keep the key out of the repo, and name the kill switch.

Migration cutover

Users see the old path until a limited audience holds.

Troubleshooting tree

Read the trace before you edit the prompt.

Ports path

A study path, not a firewall rule to paste.

Eval gate

Same tasks. Quality, safety, latency, and cost. A person owns the gate.

Agent loop

Schema, permission, result, stop. The queue still owns the person.

Emergency split

An emergency request leaves the model path.

MCP transports

Stdio has no port. Remote MCP is HTTP on a port you choose.
